name: Starter and Server Objects journeys (no connection)

steps.name: type a hostile logic name
steps.eval: const input = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Logic name"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(input, 'Customer "Summary" <script>alert(1)</script> 名前'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true

steps.name: file name stays a safe slug
choose Browse all in Server Objects
steps.eval: ([...document.querySelectorAll('#panel-starter button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Browse all in Server Objects').click(), true)

steps.name: search narrows the list
steps.eval: const input = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Search objects and methods"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(input, 'Context'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true

steps.name: clear the search
steps.eval: const input = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Search objects and methods"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(input, ''); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true

steps.name: find a member whose sample can be inserted
steps.eval: const settle = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); for (const item of document.querySelectorAll('#panel-objects button.objects-item')) { item.click(); await settle(); for (const member of document.querySelectorAll('#panel-objects [role=radiogroup][aria-label=Members] [role=radio]')) { member.click(); await settle(); const insert = [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel-objects button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Insert into handler'); if (insert && insert.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true') return member.textContent.trim(); } } return null

steps.name: insert the sample into the handler
one Ctrl+Z
steps.eval: const content = document.querySelector('.cm-content[aria-label="Server code"]'); content.focus(); content.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'z', code: 'KeyZ', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return true

steps.name: choose Back to Create Logic
steps.eval: ([...document.querySelectorAll('#panel-objects button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Back to Create Logic').click(), true)
